subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Wisdom Dressed as Nonsense
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Wisdom Dressed as Nonsense.

hook.text: Zen koans sound like nonsense: 'What is the sound of one hand clapping?' The foolishness is the point.

buildup.text: Rational thought hits a wall with koans. The mind breaks its ordinary patterns—and that's the goal.

discovery.text: Sufi and Zen masters used paradox and absurdity as teaching tools. Sacred foolishness dismantles ego.

twist.text: The fool tradition survives in comedy. Stand-up comics speak truths that journalists and politicians can't.

climax.text: When direct speech is dangerous, foolishness becomes a vehicle. The clown's mask lets forbidden truths escape.

punchline.text: The joke lands because it's true.

quiz.question: What is the purpose of a Zen koan?
options: To break the mind's ordinary thinking patterns
